    # ---- per-feature-value masks (feature alphabet is -2048..2048) -------
    rng = {}
    for b, lo, hi in bits:

        s = rng.get(k)
        if s is None:
            rng[k] = [b]
        else:
            s.append(b)
    add_at = {}
    rem_at = {}
    for k, bl in rng.items():
        add_at.setdefault(k[0], []).append(bl)
        rem_at.setdefault(k[1] + 1, []).append(bl)
    del rng, bits

    cur = bytearray(nb)
    MASKS = [None] * 4099            # MASKS[f + 2048]; index 2048 (f == 0) unused
    cache = {}
    for f in range(-2048, 2049):
        rl = rem_at.get(f)
        if rl is not None:
            for bl in rl:
                for b in bl:
                    cur[b >> 3] &= 255 ^ (1 << (b & 7))
        al = add_at.get(f)
        if al is not None:
            for bl in al:
                for b in bl:
                    cur[b >> 3] |= 1 << (b & 7)
        m = int.from_bytes(bytes(cur), "little")
        ref = cache.get(m)
        if ref is None:

            ref = m
        MASKS[f + 2048] = ref
    del cache, cur, add_at, rem_at

    # INIT forces every rule's position-0 bit on each step, so that every rule

    TERM = 0
    INIT = 0

        TL.append(0)
